units.korean-k1-unit: Irabu, konsonanti na maneno ya kwanza

korean-k1-l1.title: Irabu za msingi
korean-k1-l1.concept: Hangul ni alfabeti ya Kikorea. Kila silabi ni kibao kimoja. Irabu peke yake huandikwa na **ㅇ** mbele yake, ambayo haitamkwi mwanzoni: 아 ni “a” tu.
korean-k1-l1.example: 아 · 어 · 오 · 우 · 으 · 이 (a · eo · o · u · eu · i)

korean-k1-l2.title: Konsonanti za msingi
korean-k1-l2.concept: Weka konsonanti mbele ya irabu ili kuunda kibao cha silabi: **ㄱ + ㅏ = 가** (ga). Soma kibao kutoka kushoto kwenda kulia.
korean-k1-l2.example: 가 · 나 · 다 · 마 · 바 · 사 · 하 (ga · na · da · ma · ba · sa · ha)

korean-k1-l3.title: Maneno ya kwanza
korean-k1-l3.concept: Unganisha vibao vya silabi ili kuunda maneno. Soma kila kibao, kisha visome pamoja.

korean-k1-l4.title: Irabu za Y
korean-k1-l4.concept: Kuongeza mstari mfupi hutoa sauti ya **y**: ㅏ → ㅑ (ya), ㅓ → ㅕ (yeo), ㅗ → ㅛ (yo), ㅜ → ㅠ (yu). ㅐ (ae) na ㅔ (e) zinasikika karibu sawa katika Kikorea cha kisasa.
korean-k1-l4.example: 야 · 여 · 요 · 유 (ya · yeo · yo · yu)

korean-k1-l5.title: Konsonanti zaidi
korean-k1-l5.concept: ㄹ iko kati ya “r” na “l”. ㅈ (j), ㅊ (ch, kwa pumzi), ㅋ (k, kwa pumzi), ㅌ (t, kwa pumzi) na ㅍ (p, kwa pumzi) zinakamilisha konsonanti za msingi.
korean-k1-l5.example: 라 · 자 · 차 · 카 · 타 · 파 (ra · ja · cha · ka · ta · pa)

korean-k1-l6.title: Konsonanti pacha
korean-k1-l6.concept: ㄲ, ㄸ, ㅃ, ㅆ na ㅉ ni sauti zilizobana: zitamke kwa koo lililobana na bila pumzi, kama sauti ya kwanza katika “ski”.
korean-k1-l6.example: 까 · 따 · 빠 · 싸 · 짜 (kka · tta · ppa · ssa · jja)

korean-k1-l7.title: Konsonanti za mwisho
korean-k1-l7.concept: Konsonanti iliyo chini ya silabi huitwa **받침 (batchim)**. Hufunga silabi: 안 (an), 말 (mal), 밤 (bam), 강 (gang), 집 (jip), 책 (chaek). Sauti saba tu zinawezekana mwishoni: ㄱ ㄴ ㄷ ㄹ ㅁ ㅂ ㅇ.
korean-k1-l7.example: 안 · 말 · 밤 · 강 · 집 (an · mal · bam · gang · jip)

korean-k1-l8.title: Maneno ya kila siku
korean-k1-l8.concept: Soma kila neno silabi kwa silabi. 학교 inasomwa “hakgyo”: ㄱ ya mwisho ya 학 hufungwa na silabi inayofuata hutamkwa kwa kubana.

korean-k1-l9.title: Maneno kuhusu ulimwengu
korean-k1-l9.concept: Watu na asili: 사람 (mtu), 나라 (nchi), 하늘 (anga), 산 (mlima), 강 (mto), 꽃 (ua).

korean-k2-l1.title: Habari na asante
korean-k2-l1.concept: Salamu za heshima huishia na **-요** au **-니다**. 안녕하세요 inafaa wakati wowote wa siku.

korean-k2-l2.title: Ndiyo, hapana na sawa
korean-k2-l2.concept: Majibu mafupi ya heshima unayoweza kutumia kila siku. Kikorea huongeza **요** mwishoni ili kuonyesha heshima.

korean-k2-l3.title: Nimefurahi kukutana nawe
korean-k2-l3.concept: Unapokutana na mtu mpya, sema 만나서 반갑습니다. Kuna njia mbili za kuaga: moja kwa mtu anayeondoka, nyingine kwa mtu anayebaki.
korean-k2-l3.example: 만나서 반갑습니다. (mannaseo bangapseumnida.) = Nimefurahi kukutana nawe.

korean-k2-l4.title: Maneno ya adabu
korean-k2-l4.concept: Tumia 실례합니다 kuvutia umakini wa mtu au kupita, 고마워요 kushukuru kirafiki, 천만에요 kujibu shukrani, na 축하해요 kupongeza.

korean-k2-l5.title: Majina na nchi
korean-k2-l5.concept: Uliza jina kwa 이름이 뭐예요? na nchi kwa 어느 나라 사람이에요? Jibu kwa 제 이름은 ___예요 au 저는 ___ 사람이에요.
korean-k2-l5.example: 이름이 뭐예요? (ireumi mwoyeyo?) = Jina lako nani?

korean-k2-l6.title: Kuagana
korean-k2-l6.concept: Kati ya marafiki unaweza kusema 잘 가요 (kwa heri), 내일 봐요 (tutaonana kesho), 또 만나요 (tutaonana tena) na 잘 자요 (lala salama).
korean-k2-l6.example: 잘 가요. (jal gayo.) = Kwa heri. (kirafiki) / 내일 봐요. (naeil bwayo.) = Tutaonana kesho.

korean-k2-l7.title: Hujambo?
korean-k2-l7.concept: Uliza 잘 지냈어요? (Umekuwa mzima?) na jibu 잘 지내요 (Mimi ni mzima). 좋은 아침이에요 maana yake “Ni asubuhi njema”.
korean-k2-l7.example: 잘 지내요. (jal jinaeyo.) = Mimi ni mzima.

korean-k2-l8.title: Kuomba msaada
korean-k2-l8.concept: Sema 도와주세요 kuomba msaada, 모르겠어요 usipojua, 알겠어요 unapoelewa, na 다시 말해 주세요 kumwomba mtu aseme tena.

korean-k2-l9.title: Kupenda na kujibu
korean-k2-l9.concept: 좋아요 maana yake nzuri au sawa, 싫어요 maana yake hupendi, 맞아요 maana yake “ni sahihi” na 틀려요 maana yake “si sahihi”.

korean-k2-l10.title: Alama utakazoziona
korean-k2-l10.concept: Nchini Korea kuna alama fupi kila mahali. **입구** ni mlango wa kuingia, **출구** ni mlango wa kutoka na **화장실** ni choo. Kwenye milango, **미세요** inamaanisha sukuma na **당기세요** inamaanisha vuta.
korean-k2-l10.example: 입구 (ipgu) = Mlango wa kuingia / 출구 (chulgu) = Mlango wa kutoka

korean-k2-l11.title: Asante kwa chakula
korean-k2-l11.concept: Kabla ya kula husema **잘 먹겠습니다** na baada ya kula **잘 먹었습니다**. Mwenyeji humkaribisha mgeni kwa **어서 오세요**, na **맛있어요** ni kusifu chakula.
korean-k2-l11.example: 잘 먹겠습니다. (jal meokgetseumnida.) = Husemwa kabla ya kula: “Nitakula vizuri.” / 잘 먹었습니다. (jal meogeotseumnida.) = Husemwa baada ya kula: “Nimekula vizuri.”

korean-k3-l1.title: Mimi ni mwanafunzi
korean-k3-l1.concept: **저는** maana yake ni “mimi” (kwa heshima). Weka **이에요** baada ya konsonanti na **예요** baada ya irabu ili kusema “mimi ni …”.
korean-k3-l1.example: 저는 학생이에요. (jeoneun haksaengieyo.) = Mimi ni mwanafunzi.

korean-k3-l2.title: Familia yangu
korean-k3-l2.concept: Maneno ya familia hutumika sana katika Kikorea, hata kwa watu ambao si ndugu.

korean-k3-l3.title: Kuhesabu
korean-k3-l3.concept: Kikorea kina mifumo miwili ya namba: namba asilia za Kikorea (하나, 둘, 셋 …) za kuhesabu vitu, na namba za Kisino-Kikorea (일, 이, 삼 …) za pesa, tarehe na dakika.

korean-k3-l4.title: Namba asilia 6–10
korean-k3-l4.concept: Endelea na namba asilia za Kikorea: 여섯 (6), 일곱 (7), 여덟 (8), 아홉 (9), 열 (10).
korean-k3-l4.example: 여섯 · 일곱 · 여덟 · 아홉 · 열 (yeoseot · ilgop · yeodeol · ahop · yeol)

korean-k3-l5.title: Namba za Kisino-Kikorea
korean-k3-l5.concept: Namba za Kisino-Kikorea: 일 (1), 이 (2), 삼 (3), 사 (4), 오 (5), 육 (6), 칠 (7), 팔 (8), 구 (9), 십 (10). Hutumika kwa pesa, tarehe, namba za simu na dakika.
korean-k3-l5.example: 일 · 이 · 삼 · 사 · 오 · 육 · 칠 · 팔 · 구 · 십 (il · i · sam · sa · o · yuk · chil · pal · gu · sip)

korean-k3-l6.title: Umri
korean-k3-l6.concept: Uliza 몇 살이에요? (Una umri gani?). Umri hutumia namba asilia pamoja na 살: 열 살 (miaka 10), 스무 살 (20), 서른 살 (30).
korean-k3-l6.example: 몇 살이에요? (myeot sarieyo?) = Una umri gani?

korean-k3-l8.title: Maneno zaidi ya familia
korean-k3-l8.concept: Ndugu wana maneno tofauti kulingana na anayezungumza: mwanamke husema 오빠 (kaka mkubwa) na 언니 (dada mkubwa). Pia 아들 (mwana wa kiume), 딸 (binti), 부모님 (wazazi).
korean-k3-l8.example: 오빠 (oppa) = kaka mkubwa (anasema mwanamke) / 언니 (eonni) = dada mkubwa (anasema mwanamke)

korean-k3-l9.title: Familia yetu
korean-k3-l9.concept: Wakorea mara nyingi husema 우리 (sisi, wetu) badala ya “wangu”: 우리 가족 maana yake “familia yangu”. Hesabu watu kwa 명: 네 명 (watu wanne).

korean-k3-l10.title: Kumwandikia rafiki ujumbe
korean-k3-l10.concept: Ujumbe hutumia sentensi fupi za heshima zinazoishia **-요**. **지금 어디예요?** huuliza uko wapi sasa, **곧 가요** inamaanisha “nakuja punde” na **늦어요** inamaanisha “nitachelewa”.
korean-k3-l10.example: 지금 어디예요? (jigeum eodiyeyo?) = Uko wapi sasa? / 곧 가요. (got gayo.) = Nakuja punde.

korean-k3-l11.title: Kusoma maneno kwa sauti
korean-k3-l11.concept: Silabi inapoishia kwa konsonanti na inayofuata kuanza kwa irabu, sauti huhamia mbele: 책이 husomwa **chaegi** na 밥을 husomwa **babeul**. Baadhi ya sauti pia hubadilisha jirani zake: 국물 husomwa **gungmul** na 같이 husomwa **gachi**.

korean-k4-l1.title: Vitenzi vya kila siku
korean-k4-l1.concept: Vitenzi vya heshima vya wakati uliopo huishia na **-아요 / -어요 / -해요**. Umbo hilo hilo hutumika kwa “mimi”, “wewe” na “wao”.

korean-k4-l2.title: Kwenda mahali
korean-k4-l2.concept: Weka **에** baada ya mahali ili kusema unakokwenda au unakotoka: 학교에 가요. Kitenzi huja mwisho.

korean-k4-l3.title: Kula, kunywa, kusoma
korean-k4-l3.concept: Yambwa ya kitenzi hupata **을** baada ya konsonanti na **를** baada ya irabu: 밥을 먹어요, 커피를 마셔요.

korean-k4-l4.title: Chakula na vinywaji
korean-k4-l4.concept: 밥 (wali, mlo), 빵 (mkate), 과일 (matunda), 고기 (nyama), 물 (maji), 우유 (maziwa).

korean-k4-l5.title: Kupenda na kutopenda
korean-k4-l5.concept: Sema unachopenda kwa -를/을 좋아해요 na usichopenda kwa -를/을 싫어해요: 저는 사과를 좋아해요.

korean-k4-l6.title: Kuelezea vitu
korean-k4-l6.concept: Maneno ya kuelezea pia huishia na -요: 커요 (kubwa), 작아요 (ndogo), 많아요 (nyingi), 맛있어요 (tamu, kitamu), 예뻐요 (nzuri).
korean-k4-l6.example: 커요. (keoyo.) = Ni kubwa. / 작아요. (jagayo.) = Ni ndogo.

korean-k4-l7.title: Hali ya hewa
korean-k4-l7.concept: 날씨 (hali ya hewa), 더워요 (kuna joto), 추워요 (kuna baridi), 비가 와요 (mvua inanyesha), 눈이 와요 (theluji inanyesha).
korean-k4-l7.example: 더워요. (deowoyo.) = Kuna joto. / 추워요. (chuwoyo.) = Kuna baridi.

korean-k4-l8.title: Kukataa kwa 안 na 못
korean-k4-l8.concept: Weka **안** kabla ya kitenzi kusema hufanyi jambo (안 가요). Weka **못** kabla yake kusema huwezi (못 가요).

korean-k4-l9.title: Ratiba ya kila siku
korean-k4-l9.concept: 일어나요 (naamka), 씻어요 (naosha), 일해요 (nafanya kazi), 자요 (nalala). Maneno ya wakati kama 아침 (asubuhi) na 밤 (usiku) huchukua 에: 아침에.

korean-k5-l1.title: Jana, leo, kesho
korean-k5-l1.concept: Maneno ya wakati kwa kawaida huja karibu na mwanzo wa sentensi.

korean-k5-l2.title: Nilichofanya
korean-k5-l2.concept: Wakati uliopita: **-았어요 / -었어요 / -했어요**. Vitenzi vingine hufupishwa: 가다 → 갔어요, 보다 → 봤어요.

korean-k5-l3.title: Nitakachofanya
korean-k5-l3.concept: Tumia **-(으)ㄹ 거예요** kwa mipango: 가다 → 갈 거예요, 먹다 → 먹을 거예요.
korean-k5-l3.example: 내일 갈 거예요. (naeil gal geoyeyo.) = Nitaenda kesho.

korean-k5-l4.title: Siku za wiki
korean-k5-l4.concept: 월요일 (Jumatatu), 화요일 (Jumanne), 수요일 (Jumatano), 목요일 (Alhamisi), 금요일 (Ijumaa), 토요일 (Jumamosi), 일요일 (Jumapili).

korean-k5-l5.title: Miezi
korean-k5-l5.concept: Miezi ni namba ya Kisino-Kikorea pamoja na 월: 일월 (Januari), 삼월 (Machi), 오월 (Mei), 칠월 (Julai), 구월 (Septemba), 십이월 (Desemba).

korean-k5-l6.title: Kutaja saa
korean-k5-l6.concept: Saa hutumia namba asilia pamoja na 시: 한 시 (saa 1:00), 두 시 (2:00), 세 시 (3:00), 열 시 (10:00). Uliza 몇 시예요?
korean-k5-l6.example: 한 시 · 두 시 · 세 시 (han si · du si · se si)

korean-k5-l7.title: Mara ngapi
korean-k5-l7.concept: 매일 (kila siku), 자주 (mara nyingi), 가끔 (wakati mwingine), 항상 (daima). Ziweke kabla ya kitenzi.
korean-k5-l7.example: 매일 (maeil) = kila siku / 가끔 (gakkeum) = wakati mwingine

korean-k5-l8.title: Wakati uliopita zaidi
korean-k5-l8.concept: Kiishio cha wakati uliopita ni -았/었어요: 했어요 (alifanya), 왔어요 (alikuja), 만났어요 (alikutana), 샀어요 (alinunua), 잤어요 (alilala).

korean-k5-l9.title: Siku za kuzaliwa na wikendi
korean-k5-l9.concept: 생일 (siku ya kuzaliwa), 주말 (wikendi), 선물 (zawadi). Uliza 생일이 언제예요? na jibu 제 생일은 오월이에요.
korean-k5-l9.example: 생일이 언제예요? (saengiri eonjeyeyo?) = Siku yako ya kuzaliwa ni lini?

korean-k6-l1.title: Dukani
korean-k6-l1.concept: Uliza bei kwa 얼마예요? na omba kitu kwa **… 주세요** (… tafadhali).

korean-k6-l2.title: Iko wapi?
korean-k6-l2.concept: Uliza **… 어디예요?** (… iko wapi?). Sikiliza 오른쪽 (kulia), 왼쪽 (kushoto) na 직진 (moja kwa moja).
korean-k6-l2.example: 화장실이 어디예요? (hwajangsiri eodiyeyo?) = Choo kiko wapi?

korean-k6-l3.title: Nataka …
korean-k6-l3.concept: Ongeza **-고 싶어요** kwenye shina la kitenzi ili kusema unachotaka kufanya: 가다 → 가고 싶어요.

korean-k6-l4.title: Mgahawani
korean-k6-l4.concept: 메뉴 (menyu), 주문할게요 (nitaagiza), 물 더 주세요 (maji zaidi, tafadhali), 계산해 주세요 (bili, tafadhali).

korean-k6-l5.title: Kusafiri mjini
korean-k6-l5.concept: 버스 (basi), 지하철 (treni ya chini ya ardhi), 택시 (teksi), 기차 (treni). Sema unavyoenda kwa -로/으로: 버스로 가요.
korean-k6-l5.example: 버스 (beoseu) = basi / 지하철 (jihacheol) = treni ya chini ya ardhi

korean-k6-l6.title: Simu na ujumbe
korean-k6-l6.concept: 전화 (simu), 전화번호 (namba ya simu), 문자 (ujumbe mfupi). 전화해요 maana yake “napiga simu”.

korean-k6-l7.title: Hospitalini
korean-k6-l7.concept: 병원 (hospitali), 약 (dawa), 아파요 (inauma). Taja sehemu ya mwili kwanza: 머리가 아파요 (kichwa kinaniuma).

korean-k6-l8.title: Maombi ya heshima
korean-k6-l8.concept: -세요 na -아/어 주세요 hufanya maombi ya heshima: 앉으세요 (tafadhali keti), 기다려 주세요 (tafadhali subiri), 문을 열어 주세요 (tafadhali fungua mlango).

korean-k6-l9.title: Kupanga mipango pamoja
korean-k6-l9.concept: 같이 (pamoja) hualika mtu: 같이 가요. 갈래요? huuliza “Unataka kwenda?” na 시간 있어요? huuliza “Una wakati?”

korean-k7-l1.title: Viishio rasmi vya heshima
korean-k7-l1.concept: Katika mazungumzo rasmi na kazini, ambatisha -ㅂ니다 kwenye shina la kitenzi au kivumishi linaloishia kwa irabu, na -습니다 kwenye shina linaloishia kwa konsonanti. Maswali huishia kwa -ㅂ니까 / -습니까.
korean-k7-l1.example: 저는 학생입니다. (jeoneun haksaengimnida.) = Mimi ni mwanafunzi. / 이름이 무엇입니까? (ireumi mueosimnikka?) = Jina lako ni nani?

korean-k7-l2.title: Maumbo ya kawaida
korean-k7-l2.concept: Mtindo wa kawaida (wa maandishi) humalizia sentensi za taarifa kwa -ㄴ다 / -는다 na za wakati uliopita kwa -았다 / -었다. Maumbo haya ni msingi wa usemi wa taarifa katika masomo yajayo.
korean-k7-l2.example: 나는 학교에 간다. (naneun hakgyoe ganda.) = Ninaenda shuleni. / 동생은 책을 읽는다. (dongsaengeun chaegeul ingneunda.) = Mdogo wangu anasoma kitabu.

korean-k7-l3.title: Kuelezea nomino
korean-k7-l3.concept: Kitenzi au kivumishi kinaweza kuelezea nomino: -(으)ㄴ kwa vivumishi na vitendo vya zamani, -는 kwa vitendo vya sasa, -(으)ㄹ kwa vitendo vya baadaye au vilivyopangwa, vikiwekwa kabla ya nomino.
korean-k7-l3.example: 저는 맛있는 음식을 좋아해요. (jeoneun masinneun eumsigeul joahaeyo.) = Ninapenda chakula kitamu. / 예쁜 꽃을 샀어요. (yeppeun kkocheul sasseoyo.) = Nilinunua maua mazuri.

korean-k7-l4.title: Viunganishi vya msingi
korean-k7-l4.concept: Unganisha vishazi viwili kwa -아/어서 (sababu au mfuatano), -지만 (tofauti), -(으)니까 (sababu), -(으)면 (kama) na -(으)려고 (ili).
korean-k7-l4.example: 피곤해서 일찍 잤어요. (pigonhaeseo iljjik jasseoyo.) = Nilikuwa nimechoka, kwa hiyo nililala mapema. / 비가 와서 집에 있었어요. (biga waseo jibe isseosseoyo.) = Mvua ilinyesha, kwa hiyo nilibaki nyumbani.

korean-k7-l5.title: Uwezo, wajibu, ruhusa
korean-k7-l5.concept: -(으)ㄹ 수 있다/없다 huonyesha uwezo au uwezekano, -아/어야 하다 wajibu, na -아/어도 되다 ruhusa.
korean-k7-l5.example: 저는 수영할 수 있어요. (jeoneun suyeonghal su isseoyo.) = Ninaweza kuogelea. / 저는 한국어로 이야기할 수 있어요. (jeoneun hangugeoro iyagihal su isseoyo.) = Ninaweza kuzungumza Kikorea.

korean-k7-l6.title: Indirect statements (-다고 하다)
korean-k7-l6.concept: Report what someone says or said: verb/adj + -다고 하다.
korean-k7-l6.example: 친구가 온다고 해요. (chinguga ondago haeyo.) = friend said coming

korean-k7-l7.title: Indirect questions (-냐고 하다)
korean-k7-l7.example: 어디 가냐고 물었어요. (eodi ganyago mureosseoyo.) = asked where going

korean-k7-l8.title: Indirect commands and suggestions (-라고 / -자고 하다)
korean-k7-l8.concept: Report an imperative (-라고 하다) or propositive (-자고 하다).
korean-k7-l8.example: 빨리 오라고 했어요. (ppalli orago haesseoyo.) = told to come fast / 같이 가자고 했어요. (gachi gajago haesseoyo.) = suggested go together

korean-k7-l9.title: Complex causes and contrasts (-느라고, -는데도)
korean-k7-l9.concept: Negative cause or delay (-느라고) and contrast despite circumstances (-는데도).
korean-k7-l9.example: 공부하느라고 바빴어요. (gongbuhaneurago bapasseoyo.) = busy studying / 비가 오는데도 갔어요. (biga oneundedo gasseoyo.) = went despite rain

korean-k7-l10.title: Proportion and inevitability (-을수록, -기 마련이다)
korean-k7-l10.concept: The more... the more (-을수록) and natural inevitability (-기 마련이다).
korean-k7-l10.example: 만날수록 좋아요. (mannalsurok joayo.) = better as we meet / 사람은 실수하기 마련이에요. (sarameun silsuhagi maryeonieyo.) = bound to make mistakes

korean-k7-l11.title: Appearance and inference (-아/어 보이다, -는 모양이다)
korean-k7-l11.concept: Looks like (-아/어 보이다) and appears to be (-는 모양이다).
korean-k7-l11.example: 행복해 보여요. (haengbokae boyeoyo.) = looks happy / 비가 오는 모양이에요. (biga oneun moyangieyo.) = seems raining

korean-k7-l12.title: Pretending (-는 척하다)
korean-k7-l12.concept: Pretend to do or be something: -(으)ㄴ/는 척하다.
korean-k7-l12.example: 아는 척해요. (aneun cheokaeyo.) = pretends to know

korean-k7-l13.title: Regret and counterfactuals (-(으)ㄹ 걸 그랬어요)
korean-k7-l13.concept: Express regret: 'I should have done...' -(으)ㄹ 걸 그랬어요.
korean-k7-l13.example: 일찍 올 걸 그랬어요. (iljjik ol geol geuraesseoyo.) = should have come early

korean-k7-l14.title: K7 Comprehensive Review
korean-k7-l14.concept: Review indirect speech, complex connectors and nuanced expressions.
korean-k7-l14.example: 친구가 온다고 했어요. (chinguga ondago haesseoyo.) = friend said coming / 같이 밥 먹자고 했어요. (gachi bap meokjago haesseoyo.) = suggested eat together

korean-k8-l1.title: Honorific vocabulary for subjects
korean-k8-l1.concept: Special honorific nouns and verbs for revered people: 진지, 주무시다, 편찮으시다.
korean-k8-l1.example: 할머니께서 진지를 드세요. (halmeonikkeseo jinjireul deuseyo.) = grandmother eats meal

korean-k8-l2.title: Object honorific verbs (드리다, 뵙다, 여쭙다)
korean-k8-l2.concept: Humble/honorific verbs when the action is directed toward an elder: 드리다, 뵙다, 여쭙다.
korean-k8-l2.example: 선물을 드려요. (seonmureul deuryeoyo.) = give gift honorific / 내일 봬요. (naeil bwaeyo.) = see tomorrow honorific

korean-k8-l3.title: Affix passives (-이/히/리/기-)
korean-k8-l3.concept: Passive verbs formed by adding -이/히/리/기-: 보이다, 들리다, 열리다, 닫히다.
korean-k8-l3.example: 문이 열려요. (muni yeollyeoyo.) = door opens / 창문이 닫혀요. (changmuni dachyeoyo.) = window closes

korean-k8-l4.title: Syntactic passives (-어지다, -게 되다)
korean-k8-l4.concept: Verbs taking spontaneous or resulting passive forms: -아/어지다, -게 되다.
korean-k8-l4.example: 글씨가 써져요. (geulssiga sseojyeoyo.) = letter written well / 알게 되었어요. (alge doeeosseoyo.) = came to know

korean-k8-l5.title: Affix causatives (-이/히/리/기/우-)
korean-k8-l5.concept: Causative verbs that make someone do an action: 보여 주다, 먹이다, 입히다.
korean-k8-l5.example: 사진을 보여 줘요. (sajineul boyeo jwoyo.) = shows photo / 아기에게 밥을 먹여요. (agiege babeul meogyeoyo.) = feeds baby

korean-k8-l6.title: Syntactic causatives (-게 하다)
korean-k8-l6.concept: Make or cause someone to do something: -게 하다.
korean-k8-l6.example: 웃게 해요. (utge haeyo.) = makes laugh / 기다리게 했어요. (gidarige haesseoyo.) = made wait

korean-k8-l7.title: Public formal style (-하십시오)
korean-k8-l7.concept: High formal deferential style for announcements and ceremonies: -하십시오, -하십시다.
korean-k8-l7.example: 자리에 앉으십시오. (jarie anjeusipsio.) = please be seated / 출발하십시다. (chulbalhasipsida.) = let us depart

korean-k8-l8.title: Modest and humble expressions
korean-k8-l8.concept: Polite speech using humble pronouns and verbs: 저희, 말씀 올리다.
korean-k8-l8.example: 인사 말씀 올립니다. (insa malsseum ollimnida.) = offer greeting words / 저희 학교입니다. (jeohui hakgyoimnida.) = our school humble

korean-k8-l9.title: K8 Comprehensive Review
korean-k8-l9.concept: Review honorifics, passive, causative and formal polite registers.
korean-k8-l9.example: 할머니께 선물을 드렸어요. (halmeonikke seonmureul deuryeosseoyo.) = gave gift to grandmother / 문이 저절로 닫혔어요. (muni jeojeollo dachyeosseoyo.) = door closed by itself

korean-k9-l1.title: Business email writing and requests
korean-k9-l1.concept: Formal business email conventions: -에 관하여, 검토 부탁드립니다.
korean-k9-l1.example: 회의 안건에 관하여 말씀드립니다. (hoeui angeone gwanhayeo malsseumdeurimnida.) = regarding meeting agenda

korean-k9-l2.title: Business telephone etiquette
korean-k9-l2.concept: Handling calls and messages: 통화 가능하신지요, 연결해 드리겠습니다.
korean-k9-l2.example: 지금 통화 가능하신지요? (jigeum tonghwa ganeunghasinjiyo?) = available to speak now / 담당자를 연결해 드리겠습니다. (damdangjareul yeongyeolhae deurigetseumnida.) = connecting person in charge

korean-k9-l3.title: Scheduling and rescheduling
korean-k9-l3.concept: Proposing and changing appointment times: 변경하고자 합니다, 양해 부탁드립니다.
korean-k9-l3.example: 일정을 변경하고자 합니다. (iljeongeul byeongyeonghagoja hamnida.) = schedule change request / 너른 양해 부탁드립니다. (neoreun yanghae butakdeurimnida.) = ask kind understanding

korean-k9-l4.title: Meeting discussions and opinions
korean-k9-l4.concept: Expressing views during meetings: 제 생각으로는, 찬성합니다, 추가 검토.
korean-k9-l4.example: 제 생각으로는 이번 안이 좋습니다. (je saenggakeoroneun ibeon ani jotseumnida.) = in my opinion proposal good / 적극 찬성합니다. (jeokgeuk chanseonghamnida.) = strongly agree

korean-k9-l5.title: Reporting project progress
korean-k9-l5.concept: Giving status updates: 진행 상황을 보고합니다, 조치를 완료했습니다.
korean-k9-l5.example: 프로젝트 진행 상황을 보고합니다. (peurojekteu jinhaeng sanghwangeul bogohamnida.) = reporting project progress / 조치를 완료했습니다. (jochireul wallyohaesseumnida.) = completed action

korean-k9-l6.title: Statistical figures and data trends
korean-k9-l6.concept: Describing trends and numbers: 증가했습니다, 전년 대비.
korean-k9-l6.example: 매출이 증가했습니다. (maechuri jeunggahaesseumnida.) = sales increased / 전년 대비 상승했습니다. (jeonnyeon daebi sangseunghaesseumnida.) = increased compared to last year

korean-k9-l7.title: Business negotiations and partnerships
korean-k9-l7.concept: Professional collaboration: 상호 협력을 희망합니다, 절충안 제시.
korean-k9-l7.example: 상호 협력을 희망합니다. (sangho hyeomnyeogeul huimanghamnida.) = hope mutual cooperation / 절충안을 제안합니다. (jeolchuganeul jeanhamnida.) = propose compromise

korean-k9-l8.title: Business cards and professional titles
korean-k9-l8.concept: Exchanging cards and titles: 처음 뵙겠습니다, 명함 드립니다.
korean-k9-l8.example: 처음 뵙겠습니다, 명함 드립니다. (cheoeum boepgetseumnida, myeongham deurimnida.) = pleased to meet card / 김 부장님입니다. (gim bujangnimimnida.) = department manager kim

korean-k9-l9.title: K9 Comprehensive Review
korean-k9-l9.concept: Review professional communications, formal correspondence and meetings.
korean-k9-l9.example: 안건을 검토해 주시기 바랍니다. (angeoneul geomtohae jusigi baramnida.) = please review agenda / 회의에서 뵙겠습니다. (hoeuieseo boepgetseumnida.) = see you at meeting

korean-k10-l1.title: Headlines and compressed style
korean-k10-l1.concept: News headlines and compressed noun phrases: 물가 안정 대책 발표.
korean-k10-l1.example: 물가 안정 대책을 발표했습니다. (mulga anjeong daechaegeul balpyohaesseumnida.) = announced price measures

korean-k10-l2.title: Current affairs and editorials
korean-k10-l2.concept: Reading short news articles: 친환경 에너지가 주목받고 있습니다.
korean-k10-l2.example: 친환경 에너지가 주목받고 있습니다. (chinhwan-gyeong eneojiga jumokbatgo isseumnida.) = clean energy popular

korean-k10-l3.title: Body-part idioms (발, 눈, 귀, 손)
korean-k10-l3.concept: Common idioms with body parts: 발이 넓다 (wide network), 눈이 높다 (high standards).
korean-k10-l3.example: 김 대리는 발이 넓어요. (gim daerineun bari neobeoyo.) = has wide connections / 눈이 높아요. (nuni nopayo.) = high standards choose

korean-k10-l4.title: Everyday action idioms (바가지, 어깨)
korean-k10-l4.concept: Expressions for common situations: 바가지를 쓰다 (ripped off), 어깨가 무겁다 (heavy duty).
korean-k10-l4.example: 바가지를 썼어요. (bagajireul sseosseoyo.) = ripped off price / 어깨가 무거워요. (eokkaega mugeowoyo.) = heavy responsibility burden

korean-k10-l5.title: Essential Korean proverbs
korean-k10-l5.concept: Wisdom in proverbs: 소 잃고 외양간 고친다, 쇠뿔도 단김에 빼라.
korean-k10-l5.example: 소 잃고 외양간 고친다. (so ilko oeyanggan gochinda.) = mend barn after losing cow / 쇠뿔도 단김에 빼라. (soeppuldo dangime ppaera.) = strike while iron hot

korean-k10-l6.title: Four-character idioms (사자성어)
korean-k10-l6.concept: Common four-character Chinese-derived idioms: 일석이조, 작심삼일, 다다익선.
korean-k10-l6.example: 일석이조예요. (ilseogijoyeyo.) = two birds one stone / 작심삼일이에요. (jaksimsamirieyo.) = three days resolve

korean-k10-l7.title: Logical connectors and discourse markers
korean-k10-l7.concept: Formal discourse markers: -에 따르면, 한편, 요컨대, 따라서.
korean-k10-l7.example: 의견에 따르면 그렇습니다. (uigyone ttareumyeon geureotsseumnida.) = according to opinion / 한편 다른 측면도 있습니다. (hanpyeon dareun cheungmyeondo isseumnida.) = on other hand another aspect

korean-k10-l8.title: Deep Korean cultural values and customs
korean-k10-l8.concept: Cultural concepts and holiday traditions: 따뜻한 정, 송편을 빚다.
korean-k10-l8.example: 따뜻한 정이 있어요. (ttatteutan jeongi isseoyo.) = warm jeong affection / 송편을 빚어요. (songpyeoneul bijeoyo.) = make songpyeon chuseok

korean-k10-l9.title: K10 Comprehensive Review
korean-k10-l9.concept: Mastery of Korean culture, media, idioms and formal debate expressions.
korean-k10-l9.example: 일석이조의 효과를 거두었어요. (ilseogijoui hyogwareul geoduosseoyo.) = achieved two birds effect / 상호 이해를 바탕으로 협력해요. (sangho ihaereul batangeuro hyeomnyeokaeyo.) = cooperate based on mutual understanding
